narrative.overview:
Releases are a transit network. main and every release line are routes, each with one colour and one bullet wherever it appears; versions are stations with name plates; a work space is a branch service that runs in the colour of the line it lands in and rejoins it; landing is a ride from the space through each interchange to main. The interface reads like station signage: a black signage band on top, white ground, near-black road-sign type, and the network diagram drawn with solid route strokes, ticks and interchange rings.

Density is a working tool's: rows between hairlines, no cards, no shadows at rest. Colour is spent on two things only, route identity and state words, and the two vocabularies never share a hue. Every screen ends in a white bottom band carrying the session transcript on the left and exactly one black next action on the right, the same black as main's bullet.

The world refuses the sidebar-and-cards dashboard and the grey git-client commit graph.
keyCharacteristics: Black signage band (48px) on top: wayfinding zones, the current space with its line bullet, environment and person on the right.
Route palette owns identity: main is black "M", release lines cycle through six route colours by line number.
Line bullets and station rings are the atoms; solid 4px route strokes, 2px branch services, interchange rings.
Hairline rows are the only container; white ground, platform grey only for disabled and inset surfaces.
One filled black control per screen: the next action.

rules.name: The Two Vocabularies Rule
rules.body: Route colours identify lines; amber, red, green and edit-blue are state words. No route colour may sit on the state hues, and a state is never signalled by a route colour.

rules.name: The Word First Rule
rules.body: A state is always a word; the 7px dot and the colour reinforce it, never replace it.

rules.name: The One Black Button Rule
rules.body: The only filled black control on a screen is the next action in the action bar.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: Overpass Mono appears only for what the analyst could type or copy: cell values, column names, identifiers, hosts, version names. Never for prose or headings.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headings, buttons and zones are sentence case; nothing is set uppercase.

rules.name: The Flat Platform Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the page plane carries a shadow; only open overlays do.

dos: **Do** name every line with its bullet and its route colour, derived from `routeColour()`; never pick a line colour by hand.
**Do** keep the next action as the only black filled button, in the action bar.
**Do** say every state as a word, with the 7px dot in the state colour.
**Do** separate list items with hairline rows (rule) on the white ground.
**Do** draw routes with solid round-capped strokes and 45-degree elbows; mark versions with interchange rings and black mono name plates.
**Do** keep mono for values, identifiers and versions only.
donts: **Don't** wrap lists or sections in cards or give the page plane shadows; only open overlays float.
**Don't** use amber, red, green or edit-blue as a line colour, or a route colour as a state.
**Don't** put a second black filled control on a screen.
**Don't** draw the network as a grey git-client graph or curve its routes.
**Don't** set headings, buttons or labels in uppercase.
